Invoked by FollowButton/ProfileActions/DesktopProfileActions/CompactHeaderActions, none of which are in this screen's declared uiFiles, but the action is defined in profile.ts (an in-scope dataFile) and exists solely to back this screen's Follow control.

actions.name: toggleCommunityJoin
actions.notes: SEAM: POST /api/hub/communities/:id/join (profile.ts:30). Toggles join state for a community shown on the Community tab; mock keys state by `${wawuId}:${communityId}` composite, implying the real endpoint needs the viewing creator's id in scope even though it's nominally keyed by community id alone. Invoked via CommunityJoinButton (not in this screen's uiFiles, but wired to this dataFile action).

rolesObserved: own-profile branch reads profile.accountType === 'creator' directly (not via creatorGates()) to switch between creator and fan layouts on /profile
public profile screen assumes any signed-in viewer (no role/gate check in the read files themselves; Follow/DM/Tip affordances are unconditional on viewer role)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getOwnProfile() or getVerificationLadder() or getPurchases() throws inside profile/page.tsx's Promise.all — renders ErrorState
profile.accountType === 'creator' — shows CreatorDashboardCard + creator-only ListRows (My content, Earnings, Subscription, Verification)
profile.accountType === 'user' — shows fan ListRows (My purchases, Saved, Credits) and no CreatorDashboardCard
resolved tier (ladder 'yours' entry, or fallback profile.verification) === 'basic' — shows 'Verify to show buyers you're real'
a ladder entry has status === 'next' and current tier isn't basic — shows 'Apply to be a {label}'
no ladder entry has status === 'next' — shows 'You're at the top of the ladder'
profile/edit/page.tsx mounted, before getOwnProfile() resolves — renders Skeleton placeholders
getOwnProfile() rejects in the edit page's effect — renders ErrorState with a reload retry
getOwnProfile() resolves — draft populated, form fields rendered
submit() called and saveProfile() promise in flight — Save button reads 'Saving…' and is disabled
draft.name.trim() or draft.handle.trim() is empty (or saving is true) — Save button disabled
getCreatorProfile(wawuId) throws because wawuId isn't a key in MOCK_PROFILES — renders ErrorState 'Creator not found'
profile.content.length === 0 on the Content tab — renders EmptyState 'Nothing published yet'
profile.products.length === 0 on the Shop tab — renders EmptyState 'No shop yet'
a content item has status === 'pending' — ContentRow shows a StatusPill 'In review' instead of its price
tab is 'content' or 'community' — renders the tall FullHeader with ProfileHeader + ProfileActions
tab is 'shop' or 'about' — renders the sticky CompactHeader bar
a community entry has kind === 'private' — CommunityRow gets an accent border and a lock icon instead of the open-community users icon
profile.socials has neither instagram nor website set — the About tab's 'Elsewhere' section is omitted entirely
isFollowing(wawuId) resolves true (seeded only for wawu-zainab, or after a successful follow toggle) — Follow control shows 'Following' state

uiStatesDesigned.state: Followed — Community tab, join states differ
Shop — every item carries a handoff pill
About — response time is the useful fact
New creator — no content, DMs off, no shop; Community and Shop tabs also bare, tabs stay visible so profile shape doesn't change later
Own view — Edit profile replaces Follow, dashboard entry, drafts and pending pieces visible only here, creator bar

uiStatesDesignedSourceNote: Matched to design/screens/WAWU Creator Profile.dc.html (frames explicitly numbered 1,2,3,4,7,8 in the file — frames 5 and 6 are not present as separate captioned frames in this .dc.html, not an extraction omission). This file covers both the public creator-profile view and frame 8's own-profile view. It does NOT contain a dedicated edit-profile form frame (only an 'Edit profile' button in frame 8) — no design source for the edit form's own states (loading/saving/validation) was found, so those entries in uiStatesHandled above have no corresponding uiStatesDesigned counterpart. design/screens/WAWU Profiles Verification.dc.html was not used here — it matches the separate profile-verification screen id, not this one.
